sources.snippet: Gemma 4 is Google DeepMind's new family of open models, including 12B, E2B, E4B, 26B-A4B, and 31B. The multimodal, hybrid-thinking models support 140+ languages, up to 256K context, and have dense and MoE variants. Gemma 4 is Apache-2.0 licensed and can run on your local device.
